name: Jabin
title: Canaanite king of Hazor
summary: Jabin was a Canaanite king who ruled in Hazor and oppressed the Israelites for twenty years. The name Jabin is associated with two kings of Hazor in the Bible—one defeated by Joshua during the conquest, and another defeated through Deborah and Barak in the period of the judges. He is best known as the enemy whom God delivered into Israel's hands through the prophetess Deborah and the military commander Barak.

keyEvents.title: Jabin of Hazor defeated by Joshua
keyEvents.description: During the conquest of Canaan, Joshua led the Israelites against a coalition of Canaanite kings headed by Jabin, king of Hazor. Joshua defeated them and burned Hazor with fire.

keyEvents.title: Jabin's oppression of Israel
keyEvents.description: A later Jabin, king of Hazor, severely oppressed the Israelites for twenty years with his nine hundred iron chariots under the command of the military commander Sisera.

keyEvents.title: Deborah and Barak rise up against Jabin
keyEvents.description: The prophetess Deborah called Barak to gather ten thousand men from Naphtali and Zebulun to fight against Jabin's army led by Sisera.

keyEvents.title: Sisera's Defeat at the Brook Kishon
keyEvents.description: The Lord struck Sisera and his entire army with the edge of the sword before Barak. Jabin's military power was crushed at the Brook Kishon.

keyEvents.title: Jabin's Final Downfall
keyEvents.description: After Sisera's death, the Israelites continued to press harder and harder against Jabin until they had completely destroyed him.

keyEvents.title: Jabin's Defeat Celebrated in Deborah's Song
keyEvents.description: Deborah and Barak sang a song of praise to the Lord for the victory over Jabin's forces, and this song celebrates God's intervention on behalf of his people.
